Card Q&A.a: Yes. All [Security] effects on non-Option cards activate normally.
Card Q&A.q: When a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards performs a security check, if the checked card is a Digimon card or a Tamer card, does that card's [Security] effect activate?

a: If digivolution is performed using the [Main] effect, you must digivolve for a digivolution cost of 3.
Card Q&A.q: When I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve [Takuya Kanbara] as a level 4 red Digimon, can I digivolve by paying a cost of 4 using the standard digivolution requirements?

Effect: [Hand] [Main] By placing 1 [Agunimon] and 1 [BurningGreymon] from your trash under 1 of your [Takuya Kanbara]s, digivolve it into this card as if that card is a level 4 red Digimon for a digivolution cost of 3.
[When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait, it doesn't activate [Security] effects on Option cards it checks.
